name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. I am here to help you with race schedules, team gear, and everything Silver Arrows.
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001 for your Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team Gear is showing as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Okay, thank you for the information. I will look into that return or replacement at the official store.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. If you need anything else regarding the Silver Arrows or the upcoming races, just let me know. Have a wonderful day!
User: Thank you for the help. That is all I needed for today.
Agent Action: Call Tool end_session with args {'session_escalated': False, 'reason': 'The user has confirmed they have all the information they need and the session is complete.'}

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the mocked order status and damaged-item instructions, and the user has acknowledged the outcome.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent invoked the 'lookup_mock_merch_order' tool with order_id '1001' and explicitly stated in the response that the order was 'delivered' with tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent informed the user that they are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated, 'In our simulated mock demo system,' and the tool response included a disclaimer that the order data is mocked for demonstration purposes.
